newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh says shut atomic reactor after leakage.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh says shut atomic reactor after leakage.

text.p: Bangladesh has shut down its lone atomic reactor after it developed a leak last week, officials of Bangladesh Atomic Energy Commission (BAEC) said on Monday.
"The reactor was put off after one of its components developed a small leakage. But it is nothing dangerous. There is no emergency or any evacuation," BAEC chairman M.A. Quayum told Reuters.
"We tested the water (that) leaked out and found activity level within the international safety limit. Repair efforts are on," Quayum said without giving further details.
He said the BAEC would issue a statement on Tuesday.
The reactor at Savar, about 50 km (30 miles) north of Dhaka, is used for research and training only.
